content:
I can't do live voice calls or listen through your microphone in this chat interface. I can only exchange text here.

If you want voice interaction, options are:
- Use a platform or app that has my model integrated with voice (some apps provide speech-to-text and text-to-speech with models like mine). Tell me which app/device you have and I can guide setup.
- Locally: use speech-to-text (e.g., your OS dictation, Google Voice Typing) to convert your speech into messages, and use text-to-speech (built-in or browser extensions) to have my replies read aloud.
- Use a conferencing app (Zoom/Discord) to speak, and paste a transcript here for me to respond to, or run a local tool that connects speech I/O to the text chat.

If you tell me what device and operating system (Windows/macOS/iOS/Android) or which app you’re using, I can give step-by-step instructions to enable voice input/output. Would you like that?
